pattern: user sets the shared new-task folder through environment preferences
experience: Issue #15 moves the new-task folder preference from this browser to the server so every client on the environment uses the same value.
rule: The new-task folder is an environment-wide server preference; update it through the environment preferences tool.

setup.context: You are connected to the user's local T3 server with permission to update environment preferences.

prompt: Set the default folder for new task files on this server to /home/user/tasks so my other T3 clients use it too.
